# package opcua

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/opcua"
```

Package opcua fingerprints OPC UA over its binary transport (opc.tcp).

Detection performs the UACP hello handshake: a HEL message carrying the endpoint URL opc.tcp://host:port, to which an OPC UA server replies with ACK (the negotiated buffer sizes) or, when the URL does not match its configured endpoint, with ERR and a UA status code — both identify OPC UA, since no other protocol frames a "HELF"/"ACKF"/"ERRF" message.

In identify mode an anonymous secure channel is opened with security policy None and GetEndpoints is called, returning the server's application description (name, application and product URIs) and the security policies on offer. No session is created and nothing is read.
